d.17 Sin mediar pago alguno, este hogar, ¿recibe ayuda de otros familiares o conocidos que no integran el hogar para limpiar la vivienda, cuidar niños o ancianos o para realizar alguna otra tarea doméstica?

assessments.reasoning: The instrument records member-to-member relationships using pointer variables for mother's ID (question e.23), father's ID (question e.24), and partner/spouse's ID (question e.25), establishing member_to_member_relationships as true. Ties beyond spouse and parent-child are captured through extended relationship categories in question e.22 (e.g., yerno/nuera, suegro/a, hermano/a, cuñado/a, nieto/a, otro pariente, otro no pariente) and union types in question e.26 (including same-sex unions), establishing extended_ties as true. Criteria for separating households within a dwelling are explicitly stated in question c.14 based on sharing a common food fund ('dependen de un mismo fondo de alimentación'), establishing multiple_household_criteria as true. Sub-units (family nuclei or secondary families) within the household can be identified through the combination of pointer variables (mother, father, partner IDs) and detailed relationship classifications, establishing sub_units as true. Questions d.16 and d.17 ask whether the household pays for domestic work/care or receives unpaid external domestic help, but no question identifies specific individual caregiving relationships mapping who provides care to whom inside or across households, establishing caregiving_relationships as false.
